'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At an apartment [[construction]] site in [[Gwangju]], [[South Korea]], an outer wall of the building collapses, trapping six workers. [https://apnews.com/article/business-seoul-south-korea-f7d2e7a0e627c98dc7b0fffece3a4ae6/ (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Canada]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Quebec]]
****[[Quebec]] announces plans to impose a "significant" tax on those who are not vaccinated against COVID-19, with exemptions for those who have legitimate medical exemptions from taking the vaccine. However, few additional details were revealed on a policy which would be a first in [[Canada]]. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/article-quebec-to-impose-tax-on-unvaccinated/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports a record 368,149 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/01/11/france-reports-new-covid-infection-record-with-omicron-spreading.html (CNBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a record 220,532 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 7.77 million. [https://www.agi.it/cronaca/news/2022-01-11/bollettino-covid-11-gennaio-2021-15199343/ (Agenzia Italia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] surpasses 100,000 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths from COVID-19]], becoming the 15th nation to do so. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/poland-covid-death-toll-b1990538.html (''The Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Serbia]]
****[[Patriarch Porfirije]], the head of the [[Serbian Orthodox Church]], tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-01-11/head-of-serbian-orthodox-church-tests-positive-for-virus (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia]]
****[[Slovenia]] reports a record 5,164 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://sloveniatimes.com/record-5164-new-cases-of-coronavirus-reported-for-monday/ (''The Slovenia Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record 74,266 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/turkiye-reports-over-74-200-new-covid-19-cases-hitting-record-daily-figure/2471374 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina]] reports a record 134,439 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 6,533,635. [https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2022/01/11/covid-imparable-argentina-volvio-a-superar-su-record-de-contagios-con-134439-casos-en-un-dia/ (''Infobae'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bolivia]]
****[[Bolivia]]n [[Vice President of Bolivia|vice president]] [[David Choquehuanca]] tests positive for COVID-19 for the third time. Six [[Cabinet of Bolivia|government minister]]s also test positive for COVID-19. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220111-third-covid-infection-for-bolivian-vp-who-touts-traditional-medicine (France 24)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
***The [[Israel]]i [[Ministry of Health (Israel)|Health ministry]] approves a reduction of the isolation period for asymptomatic positive COVID-19 patients from ten to seven days in order to keep the economy running despite an increase in the number of [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] cases. The changes will be in effect on January 13. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-cuts-quarantine-for-asymptomatic-covid-patients-to-7-days/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
* [[President of the European Parliament]] [[David Sassoli]] dies in [[Aviano]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/european-parliament-president-david-sassoli-dies-aged-65/ (''Politico'')]
* Maltese [[Member of European Parliament|MEP]] [[Roberta Metsola]] becomes acting President of the European Parliament. Metsola is the first Maltese person to hold this position. [https://www.politico.eu/article/european-parliament-president-david-sassoli-dies-aged-65/ (''Politico'')]
